question: The scientific name for the domestic ______ is Canis lupus familiaris.
solution:
The correct answer is the **__dog__.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The scientific name for the domestic dog is Canis lupus familiaris.**
 
• **Dog is a **domestic mammal of the** family Canidae (order Carnivora).**
 
• It is a** subspecies of the gray wolf (Canis lupus) **and is** related to foxes and jackals.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Cat **

 
 
• **​Felis silvestris catus **is the scientific name for the** domestic, or house cat.**
 
• The closest relative is the species **Felis silvestris lybica , the African Wild Cat.**
 
 
 
• **Buffalo​**
 
 
• ​The scientific name generally used for water buffalo is **Bubalus Bubalis.**
 
• **Belongs to the Bovidae family** which also includes other **cloven-hoofed ruminants such as goats, sheep, and antelopes.**
 
• Found on the** Indian subcontinent, China, Southeast Asia, Australia, Europe, North America, and South America.**
 
 
 
• **​Cow**
 
 
• **Domesticated cows (Bos taurus) belong to the family Bovidae.**
 
• Cattle are mostly** raised for milk, meat, and leather.**
 
• Cows are also used as** draft animals (animals that pull carts or plough agricultural fields).**​
